about.label: Biography
about.title: A personal voice on the drum kit.
about.p1: Drummer / composer Sebastien Delacombaz is an eclectic musician, currently active on the international scene. Drawing inspiration from a myriad of musical horizons, Sebastien sets himself apart with a unique compositional style, and a personal voice on the drum-kit that allows him to thrive not only as a leader but also as a sideman in a variety of ensembles.
about.p2: Sebastien got his start playing jazz in his home country of Switzerland, at JazzCampus in Basel, and subsequently studied at the Conservatory of Amsterdam, where he completed a Bachelor and Master's degree in performance alongside coaching in contemporary composition.
about.p3: He has had the opportunity to study with some of the best jazz musicians of today, including Mark Turner, Jeff Ballard, Jorge Rossy, Bill McHenry, Julio Barreto and composer Guillermo Klein. He has also been mentored by renowned Dutch drummers Martijn Vink, Lucas Van Merwijk, Marcel Serierse and Yoran Vroom during his time in Amsterdam.
about.p4: For the past few years, Sebastien has performed consistently around Europe, and is now leading his own ensembles, among others the quintet FI:LDS, which made its debut on the stage of the Bimhuis in Amsterdam.
education: Bachelor in Jazz performance — Conservatory of Amsterdam
Master in Jazz performance — Conservatory of Amsterdam
about.teaching: Sebastien has been teaching in Amsterdam and Geneva for several years, with students of all ages and levels. Lessons are offered in English and French, in person or remotely.

music.label: Music
music.title: FI:LDS & selected works
music.fieldsP1: FI:LDS is a project led by Swiss drummer / composer Sebastien Delacombaz. This quintet — alto and tenor saxophone, double bass, piano and drums — offers a fresh take on a classic jazz instrumentation that transcends stylistic boundaries.
music.fieldsP2: Alongside the band-leader, the ensemble features some of the upcoming talents of the Amsterdam jazz scene: Marios Charalampous on tenor saxophone, Michael Murray on alto saxophone, Joy Shecter on piano and Aniol Torrents on double bass.
music.worksIntro: A selection of original compositions, performed by various ensembles.

lessons.label: Lessons
lessons.title: Learn the drums, remotely.
lessons.intro: Finding the right teacher is what makes learning an instrument fruitful and enjoyable. After years as an educator and performing musician, Sebastien has developed a method that follows each student's musical aspirations while building a strong foundation on the instrument.
lessons.method: Technique, reading, vocabulary, groove, improvisation and repertoire — adapted to your level, from complete beginner to conservatory preparation. Rock, metal, funk, fusion, jazz, gospel and beyond.
lessons.format: Sessions take place on Zoom or Google Meet. You need a practice pad or drum kit, a camera that shows your hands and posture, and a stable connection. A video link is sent once the booking is confirmed.
lessons.audience: Children, teenagers, adults and seniors — beginner to advanced. Taught in English and French.
lessons.discoveryText: A first session to define goals, assess your level and start playing.
lessons.standardText: The regular format: technique, repertoire and a clear practice plan.
lessons.extendedText: More time for advanced work, transcriptions or audition preparation.
lessons.bookIntro: Choose a format, a date and a time. Sebastien confirms by email or WhatsApp and sends the video link.
